svg.title: A watch movement running, from the barrel to the escapement
svg.desc: A mechanical watch movement runs ten times slower than life: the balance swings, its pin throws the pallet fork from side to side, and the escape wheel steps a tooth at a time, turning the fourth and third wheels behind it. The view travels from the mainspring barrel down the train to the escapement, closes in on the impulse pin and then on the two ruby stones, and pulls back.
